questions.question: A 300 { m} long train moving with a speed of 126 { km/h} crossses a platform in 12 seconds. A boy crosses the same platform in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the boy in {m/s} ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert speed: 126 km/h = 35 m/s

Total distance (train + platform) = 35 × 12 = 420 m

Platform length = 420 − 300 = 120 m

Boy speed = 120 ÷ 15 = 8 m/s

**∴ Answer = 8 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train = 300 m

Speed of train = 126 km/h

Time to cross platform = 12 s

Time for boy = 15 s

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert speed: 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

⇒ Total distance (train + platform) = 35 × 12 = 420 m

⇒ Platform length = 420 − 300 = 120 m

⇒ Boy’s speed = 120 ÷ 15

⇒ = 8 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 8 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

km/h to m/s = multiply by 5/18

Train Crossing Platform

Total distance = train length + platform length

Basic Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

questions.question: Two successive increase of 40\% each is by what percent more than two successive decrease of 40\% each?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective % change for two successive changes of x% and y% is given by [x + y + (xy ÷ 100)]%.

Effective increase = 40 + 40 + (40 × 40) ÷ 100 = 96%.

Effective decrease = 40 + 40 − (40 × 40) ÷ 100 = 64% (in magnitude).

Required percentage more = [(96 − 64) ÷ 64] × 100 = (32 ÷ 64) × 100 = 50%.

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive increase of 40% each.

Successive decrease of 40% each.

**Formula Used:**

Successive % change = [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%

Percentage more = [(Value 1 − Value 2) ÷ Value 2] × 100%

 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 96%
 Increase
 
 
 64%
 Decrease
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 

 

 

 
 Diff = 32%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial value be 100.

⇒ Two successive increases of 40% = 100 × (140 ÷ 100) × (140 ÷ 100) = 196.

⇒ Effective increase percentage = 196 − 100 = 96%.

⇒ Two successive decreases of 40% = 100 × (60 ÷ 100) × (60 ÷ 100) = 36.

⇒ Effective decrease percentage = 100 − 36 = 64%.

⇒ Difference between the two effective changes = 96 − 64 = 32.

⇒ Required percentage more = (Difference ÷ Effective decrease) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = (32 ÷ 64) × 100 = 50%.

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is subjected to two successive changes of a% and b%, the net change is given by [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%. Use positive signs for increase and negative signs for decrease.

Percentage More or Less

To find what percent a value A is more than B, use the formula: [(A − B) ÷ B] × 100%.

Same Successive Increase and Decrease

If a number is successively increased by x% and then decreased by x%, there is always a net decrease of (x² ÷ 100)% overall.

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 20 min and 35 min, respectively. Both Pipe A and Pipe B are opened together. After how much time should Pipe A be turned off so that the empty cistern is completely filled in a total of 28 min?
questions.solution:

Let total work = LCM(20, 35) = 140 units

A = 140 ÷ 20 = 7 units/min, B = 140 ÷ 35 = 4 units/min

Let A runs for x min, B runs full 28 min

Total work: 7x + 4×28 = 140

⇒ 7x + 112 = 140 ⇒ 7x = 28 ⇒ x = 4

**∴ Answer = 4 minutes**

questions.question: {Solve: } ((11)³ - (10)³)/((11)² + 11 times 10 + (10)²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a³ − b³) ÷ (a² + ab + b²) = a − b

Here a = 11, b = 10

So value = 11 − 10

= 1

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(11³ − 10³) ÷ (11² + 11 × 10 + 10²)

**Concept Used:**

Identity: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Numerator = (11 − 10)(11² + 11 × 10 + 10²)

⇒ Expression = [(11 − 10)(11² + 11×10 + 10²)] ÷ (11² + 11×10 + 10²)

⇒ Cancel common term

⇒ = 11 − 10

⇒ = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

Cancellation Trick

If same expression appears in numerator and denominator, cancel directly.

Algebra Shortcut

Recognize standard identities to avoid long calculations.

questions.question: What is the least number that should be added to 443 so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 12, 5 and 6?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 12, 5, 6 = 60

Nearest multiple of 60 above 443 = 480

Required number = 480 − 443 = 37

**∴ Answer = 37**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 443

Divisible by 12, 5 and 6

**Formula used:**

Required number = LCM − (Number mod LCM)

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 12, 5, 6 = 60

⇒ 443 ÷ 60 gives remainder = 23

⇒ Required addition = 60 − 23 = 37

**∴ The correct answer is 37.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Concept

To make a number divisible by multiple numbers, use their LCM.

Remainder Method

Addition needed = LCM − remainder

Shortcut Idea

Find next multiple of LCM greater than given number.

questions.question: {What is the volume (in cm}³{) of a sphere having diameter 18 cm? (Use } pi = 3.1)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius of the sphere (r) = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

V = (4/3) × 3.1 × 9³

V = 4 × 3.1 × 243 = 3013.2

**∴ The correct answer is 3013.2 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• r = 9 cm Diameter (d) = 18 cm 

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 18 cm

Value of π = 3.1

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 3.1 × 9³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 3.1 × (9 × 9 × 9)

⇒ Volume = 4 × 3.1 × (9 × 9 × 3)

⇒ Volume = 12.4 × 243

⇒ Volume = 3013.2

**∴ The correct answer is 3013.2 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Its volume is given by V = (2/3) × π × r³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a complete sphere is calculated using the formula A = 4 × π × r².

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area includes the curved surface area and the flat circular base, given by TSA = 3 × π × r².

questions.question: The expenditure of Sudha is 100% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 4% and savings increase by 26%, then by what percentage does her income increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expenditure = 100% more than savings ⇒ E : S = 2 : 1

Take S = 100, E = 200 ⇒ Income = 300

New E = 200 × 0.96 = 192, New S = 100 × 1.26 = 126

New Income = 192 + 126 = 318

Increase = 318 − 300 = 18 ⇒ % increase = (18/300)×100 = 6%

**∴ Answer = 6%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenditure is 100% more than savings

Expenditure decreases by 4%, savings increase by 26%

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let savings = x

⇒ Expenditure = 2x

⇒ Income = 3x

⇒ New expenditure = 2x × 96/100 = 1.92x

⇒ New savings = x × 126/100 = 1.26x

⇒ New income = 1.92x + 1.26x = 3.18x

⇒ Increase = 3.18x − 3x = 0.18x

⇒ % increase = (0.18x ÷ 3x) × 100

⇒ = 6%

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Ratio Method

Convert percentage relation into ratio for easy calculation.

Percentage Change

Apply multipliers like 0.96 and 1.26 for changes.

questions.question: Train A departs from station X at 8:00 AM and travels towards station Y at a speed of 50 km/hr. Train B departs from station Y at 9:00 AM and travels towards station X at a speed of 60 km/hr. If the two trains meet at 9:45 AM, find one-fourth of the distance between stations X and Y (in km).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time of A = 8:00 to 9:45 = 1.75 hr

Time of B = 9:00 to 9:45 = 0.75 hr

Distance = (50 × 1.75) + (60 × 0.75)

= 87.5 + 45 = 132.5 km

One-fourth = 132.5 ÷ 4 = 33.125

**∴ Answer = 33.125 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train A = 50 km/hr (starts at 8:00 AM)

Speed of Train B = 60 km/hr (starts at 9:00 AM)

Meeting time = 9:45 AM

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for A = 1 hour 45 min = 1.75 hr

⇒ Distance by A = 50 × 1.75 = 87.5 km

⇒ Time for B = 45 min = 0.75 hr

⇒ Distance by B = 60 × 0.75 = 45 km

⇒ Total distance = 87.5 + 45 = 132.5 km

⇒ One-fourth = 132.5 ÷ 4 = 33.125 km

**∴ The correct answer is 33.125 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Motion

When two objects move towards each other, total distance = sum of distances covered.

Time Conversion

Convert minutes into hours before calculation.

Basic Formula

Distance = Speed × Time

questions.question:

= 1155 litres

⇒ = (1/2) × (22/7) × 12.25 = 19.25 cm²

questions.question: In a quadrilateral IJKL, ∠I = 35° and ∠J = 24°. The bisectors of ∠K and ∠L meet at Z. What is the measure of ∠LZK?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of any two adjacent angles in a quadrilateral is exactly half the sum of the remaining two angles.

∠LZK = (∠I + ∠J) ÷ 2

∠LZK = (35° + 24°) ÷ 2

∠LZK = 59° ÷ 2 = 29.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 29.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠I = 35° and ∠J = 24°

Z is the intersection point of the angle bisectors of ∠K and ∠L.

 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 I
 J
 K
 L
 Z
 
 
 35°
 24°
 ?
 
 
 

 

 
 

 

**Calculations:**

The sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°.

⇒ ∠I + ∠J + ∠K + ∠L = 360°

⇒ 35° + 24° + ∠K + ∠L = 360°

⇒ 59° + ∠K + ∠L = 360°

⇒ ∠K + ∠L = 360° − 59° = 301°

In ΔLZK, the sum of all interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠LZK + ∠ZLK + ∠ZKL = 180°

Since LZ and KZ are angle bisectors, ∠ZLK = ∠L ÷ 2 and ∠ZKL = ∠K ÷ 2.

⇒ ∠LZK + (∠L ÷ 2) + (∠K ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠LZK + (∠K + ∠L) ÷ 2 = 180°

⇒ ∠LZK + (301° ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠LZK + 150.5° = 180°

⇒ ∠LZK = 180° − 150.5° = 29.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 29.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by the formula: (n − 2) × 180°. For a quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum is exactly 360°.

Angle Bisectors of a Quadrilateral

If the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral meet at a single point, the angle formed by their intersection is exactly half the sum of the remaining two angles: ∠AOB = (∠C + ∠D) ÷ 2.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

If a quadrilateral is inscribed within a circle such that all four vertices lie on the circumference, the sum of its opposite angles is always equal to 180°. For example, ∠A + ∠C = 180°.

Add both equations

(2M + 3S) + (3M + 2S) = 1980 + 1920

⇒ 5M + 5S = 3900

questions.question: {If } tan theta = sqrt{3}, { where } theta { is an acute angle, then what is the value of } sec theta?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From the standard trigonometric values, we know that tan 60° = √3.

Since θ is given as an acute angle (less than 90°), we directly determine θ = 60°.

We are required to find the value of sec θ, which translates to sec 60°.

The value of cos 60° is 1/2, and its reciprocal sec 60° = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ tan θ = √3

**Formula Used:**

⇒ tan θ = Perpendicular / Base

⇒ Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base² (Pythagoras Theorem)

⇒ sec θ = Hypotenuse / Base

 
 
 
 θ A B C √3 1 2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ From tan θ = √3 / 1, we can establish Perpendicular = √3 and Base = 1

⇒ Substituting values into the Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ Hypotenuse² = (√3)² + 1²

⇒ Hypotenuse² = 3 + 1 = 4

⇒ Hypotenuse = √4 = 2

⇒ We know that sec θ = Hypotenuse / Base

⇒ sec θ = 2 / 1 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

In a right-angled triangle, the primary ratios are defined as: sin θ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse, cos θ = Base / Hypotenuse, and tan θ = Perpendicular / Base.

Reciprocal Identities

The inverses of the primary trigonometric ratios are: sec θ = 1 / cos θ, cosec θ = 1 / sin θ, and cot θ = 1 / tan θ.

Pythagorean Identities

The foundational identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

questions.question: An uncle is currently six times as old as his nephew. In 20 years from now, he will be only twice as old. Find the nephew's current age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let nephew = x, uncle = 6x

After 20 years: 6x + 20 = 2(x + 20)

⇒ 6x + 20 = 2x + 40 ⇒ 4x = 20 ⇒ x = 5

**∴ Answer = 5 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Uncle is 6 times nephew's age

After 20 years, uncle = 2 times nephew

**Formula used:**

Form linear equation using age relation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let nephew's present age = x

⇒ Uncle's present age = 6x

⇒ After 20 years:

⇒ Uncle = 6x + 20

⇒ Nephew = x + 20

⇒ Equation: 6x + 20 = 2(x + 20)

⇒ 6x + 20 = 2x + 40

⇒ 4x = 20

⇒ x = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: {Simplify}: 18 - [6 - {4 - (8 - 6 - 3)}]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly, simplifying from the innermost brackets outwards.

⇒ (8 − 6 − 3) = −1

⇒ {4 − (−1)} = 4 + 1 = 5

⇒ [6 − 5] = 1

⇒ 18 − 1 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

18 − [6 − {4 − (8 − 6 − 3)}]

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Simplify expressions in the order of Brackets ( ), then { }, and finally [ ]. Always evaluate operations of the same precedence from left to right inside the brackets.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 18 − [6 − {4 − (8 − 6 − 3)}]

⇒ 18 − [6 − {4 − (2 − 3)}]

⇒ 18 − [6 − {4 − (−1)}]

⇒ 18 − [6 − {4 + 1}]

⇒ 18 − [6 − 5]

⇒ 18 − 1 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the exact sequence for solving a mathematical expression: Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Order of Brackets

Brackets must be solved in the precise order: Vinculum or bar ( ̅ ), followed by parentheses ( ), curly braces { }, and finally square brackets [ ].

Sign Rules for Operations

Subtracting a negative number is equivalent to adding a positive number: −(−x) = +x.

questions.question: The average of the squares of the first 4 natural numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for the average of the squares of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Here, the number of terms (n) = 4.

⇒ Average = (4 + 1)(2 × 4 + 1) ÷ 6

⇒ Average = (5 × 9) ÷ 6 = 45 ÷ 6

⇒ Average = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The first 4 natural numbers are 1, 2, 3, and 4.

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
• 1 1st 4 2nd 9 3rd 16 4th 
• Avg = 7.5 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Squares of the first 4 natural numbers = 1², 2², 3², 4²

⇒ Values = 1, 4, 9, 16

⇒ Sum of the squares = 1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30

⇒ Total number of observations = 4

⇒ Average = 30 ÷ 4

⇒ Average = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to find the average of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of Squares of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to find the average of the squares of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Average of Cubes of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to find the average of the cubes of the first n natural numbers is n(n + 1)² ÷ 4.

questions.question: If 63 : A :: A : 175, then find the positive value of A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional 'x' of two numbers 'a' and 'b' in a continuous proportion is calculated as x = √(a × b).

Here, the required positive value A acts as the mean proportional for 63 and 175.

A = √(63 × 175)

A = √(9 × 7 × 25 × 7) = 3 × 7 × 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Proportion relation: 63 : A :: A : 175

**Formula Used:**

In a proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of the means equals the product of the extremes (b × c = a × d).

 

 Product of Extremes = 63 × 175

 Product of Means = A × A

**Calculations:**

⇒ A × A = 63 × 175

⇒ A² = (9 × 7) × (25 × 7)

⇒ A² = 9 × 25 × 49

⇒ A = √(9 × 25 × 49)

⇒ A = 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ A = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

For any two numbers a and b, the mean proportional x is calculated using the formula x = √(a × b).

Third Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional c satisfies the condition a : b :: b : c, which gives c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three given numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies a : b :: c : d, leading to the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Properties of Proportion

In any valid proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of the extreme terms (a × d) is always mathematically equal to the product of the mean terms (b × c).

questions.question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 20%, 5% and 21% (rounded off to two decimal places).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective % = 100 × 0.80 × 0.95 × 0.79

= 60.04%

**∴ Answer = 60.04%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discounts = 20%, 5%, 21%

**Formula used:**

Effective price % = 100 × (1 − d1/100) × (1 − d2/100) × (1 − d3/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 20% ⇒ 100 × 80/100 = 80

⇒ After 5% ⇒ 80 × 95/100 = 76

⇒ After 21% ⇒ 76 × 79/100 = 60.04

**∴ The correct answer is 60.04%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Multiplier Method

Use (1 − d/100) repeatedly for each discount.

Successive Discount

Discounts are applied one after another, not added.

Effective Price
